definitions.explanation: Saving a file by replacing the existing version with the updated one. The standard "Save" command in most software applications, as opposed to "Save As."

examples.japanese: {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: Do you want to overwrite and save?

examples.japanese: Ctrl+S⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can overwrite save with Ctrl+S.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまい、⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally overwrote the file and the original was lost.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{上書|うわが}き→上書き：16330_uwagaki⟧ (overwriting) and ⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧ (saving, preservation). This is the Japanese equivalent of the "Save" function in most software menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to overwrite save)
- {上書|うわが}き{保存|ほぞん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？ (Do you want to save?)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: Save As
- {自動保存|じどうほぞん}: auto-save
